names: Distarch phosphate esterified with sodium trimetasphosphate; esterified with phosphorus oxychloride (stabiliser)
display_name: E1412 (Distarch phosphate esterified with sodium trimetasphosphate; esterified with phosphorus oxychloride)

more_info.uses: EU permissions include milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children, unflavoured live fermented cream products and substitute products, both with a fat  content of less than 20 %. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Starch is crosslinked using sodium trimetaphosphate or phosphorus oxychloride. The product is a chemically modified carbohydrate.
more_info.overview: Distarch phosphate esterified with sodium trimetasphosphate; esterified with phosphorus oxychloride is classified in food technology as a thickening agent. Its technological role is to increase thickness.
